title: Six Wordstat API routes exposed internal exception text
original_report: Completion audit found two approved batches of reachable Wordstat API exception handlers returning str(exception), contrary to the standardized safe API error contract.

candidates.contract: Internal failures return code, safe message and request_id without exception text.
candidates.trigger: Authenticated request while keyword collection raises an internal exception.

candidates.contract: Internal failures return code, safe message and request_id without exception text.
candidates.trigger: Authenticated request while search preparation raises an internal exception.

candidates.contract: Internal failures return code, safe message and request_id without exception text.
candidates.trigger: Metadata file read raises an internal exception.

candidates.contract: Internal failures return code, safe message and request_id without exception text.
candidates.trigger: Authenticated refresh request while domain refresh raises an internal exception.

candidates.contract: Internal failures return code, safe message and request_id without exception text.
candidates.trigger: Authenticated exclusion request while persistence raises an internal exception.

candidates.contract: Internal failures return code, safe message and request_id without exception text.
candidates.trigger: Authenticated custom-keyword request while persistence raises an internal exception.

expected: Each 500 response contains only code=internal_error, a safe user message and request_id.
actual: All six endpoints returned the full injected internal exception text in their JSON responses before their approved batch fix.
environment: LocalOS ARM64 Python 3.11 test environment; no database, provider or production calls
reproduction: Focused Flask tests inject a deterministic internal error into the real route handler and assert the shared safe error contract.
failure_signal: Batch one changed from 3 failed to 3 passed. Batch two changed from 3 failed plus 3 passed to all 6 passed.
root_cause: Six catch-all handlers serialized str(exception) directly into client-facing JSON instead of using core.api_errors.internal_error_response.
fix_summary: Imported internal_error_response and replaced only the six proven 500 responses with route-specific safe messages in two approved batches.
why_causal: The changed statements are the only response construction points reached by the deterministic failing branches; success, validation, authorization and cleanup paths are unchanged.

reproduction_files.summary: Three endpoint regressions approved at Gate 1.

fix_files.summary: Safe shared error response applied to the three approved branches at Gate 2.

checks.name: Exact reproducer
checks.detail: Batch one: 3 failed to 3 passed. Batch two: 3 failed plus 3 passed to 6 passed.

limitations: This package covers the six approved Wordstat routes only; other legacy API modules require separate candidate batches and approval gates.
residual_risks: Production deployment and live smoke remain separately gated.
Provider credential rotation remains separately gated.
notes: No provider API, production service or production data was used or changed.
Success responses, authorization, tenant checks, rollback and connection close behavior remain unchanged.
